release_notes: Performance release: single-pass whisper decode (no silent 6x fallback re-decodes), resample/trim moved off the main thread (no UI hitch on hotkey release), zero-allocation audio tap, cached vocabulary regexes, far less menu-bar redraw churn while recording, async history writes. Whisper CPU libs now built against a portable Apple Silicon baseline (M1+) instead of the build machine's chip.
